name: SAME Virginia Tech STEM Camp
org: Society of American Military Engineers (SAME), Central Virginia Post
what_you_do: Overnight camp with engineering design challenges, drone and robotics activities, construction projects, and tours of STEM labs, construction sites and the Virginia Tech campus.
who_can_apply: Rising high school sophomores, juniors and seniors. You must be a U.S. citizen and at least 15. You must be on a college prep track in math and science. You must plan a path in architecture, engineering, construction or a related field.
pay_detail: $500. Accepted students pay a $50 deposit by May 30, 2027. No fee to apply.
deadline_text: Apply by Feb 19, 2027. Camp runs July 13 to 16, 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. You and a parent both sign it. Questions: info@same-vatech-stemcamp.org.
notes: Campers stay in university housing at Virginia Tech. Applicants hear back by Apr 1, 2027.
